link.note: Thomas Lamoreaux's will (1815/1826, Luzerne Will Book A pp.341-3) names 'Martha Pringle' among his daughters; Harvey Book calls her his eldest daughter, m. Samuel Pringle 1790. Upgraded to confirmed (primary) in Round 3.

summary: John's 5th-great-grandmother; eldest daughter of Revolutionary patriot Ensign Thomas Lamoreaux - the link that carries John's SAR line.
bio: Martha was the eldest daughter (born BET 1770 AND 1772) of Thomas and Keturah (Tuttle) Lamoreaux and married Samuel Pringle in 1790 (Harvey Book pp.134-135). She was therefore born about 1770-72. The tree's birth of 1776 ('1776-Deceased') and WikiTree's 18 Oct 1776, only 18 days after her sister Elizabeth's 30 Sep 1776, plus WikiTree's death date of 27 Aug 1859 (also Elizabeth's), look copied from Elizabeth; her real death date is unverified. Her father's will names 'Martha Pringle'. The SAR's record for Thomas lists Martha among his children, but all three approved applications (1995, 2014, 2017) go through his sons James or Thomas; John's application would open a new line through Martha.
sources: WikiTree Lamoreaux-21 (Thomas Lamoreaux; full will transcription citing FamilySearch images of Luzerne Will Book A): https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Lamoreaux-21 ; PAGenWeb will transcription: http://www.pagenweb.org/~luzerne/patk/tomlam.htm
